headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox continued their dominance over the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 5-3 victory and a shutout win in the same series. The Los Angeles Dodgers edged the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run. The Atlanta Braves routed the Texas Rangers 15-1, with Chris Sale earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their team's lineup and rotation. Chris Bassitt, a right-hander for the Baltimore Orioles, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. Other notable injuries include JoJo Romero, a left-hander for the St. Louis Cardinals, and Brice Matthews, a center fielder for the Houston Astros.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several teams making moves to bolster their rosters. The Baltimore Orioles acquired outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash. The Washington Nationals traded center fielder Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Houston Astros traded right-hander Lance McCullers Jr., left-hander Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them their latest defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Rays 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Wilyer Abreu leading the charge at the plate. Abreu's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers took down the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run in the win. Muncy's 18th homer of the season came on a fly ball to right field, scoring Mookie Betts.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers in a lopsided 15-1 victory, with Chris Sale earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Drake Baldwin led the Rangers with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Bassitt Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. The move comes after Bassitt was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Rudy Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have added outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Kansas City Royals for cash. Martin Jr. joins the Orioles after the trade was finalized.
